v.en: O God, come to my assistance;

r.en: O Lord, make haste to help me.

source.scope: Psalmi & antiphonæ ex Psalterio secundum diem

text.la: Qui hábitas in cælis, * miserére nobis.
text.en: Thou who dwellest in heaven, * have mercy on us.
Our help is * in the name of the Lord.

text.la: In circúitu pópuli sui * Dóminus, ex hoc nunc et usque in sǽculum.
text.en: The Lord standeth round his people * from this time forth and for evermore.

text.la: Magnificávit Dóminus * fácere nobíscum: facti sumus lætántes.
text.en: The Lord hath * done great things for us, whereof we rejoice.

text.la: Dóminus ædíficet * nobis domum, et custódiat civitátem.
text.en: The Lord builds * the house and keeps the city.

text.la: Iustórum ánimæ in manu Dei sunt, et non tanget illos torméntum mortis. Visi sunt óculis insipiéntium mori: illi autem sunt in pace.
text.en: But the souls of the just are in the hand of God, and the torment of death shall not touch them. In the sight of the unwise they seemed to die, but they are in peace.

v.en: The saints shall rejoice in glory:

r.en: They shall be joyful in their beds.

text.la: Gaudent in cælis * ánimæ Sanctórum, qui Christi vestígia sunt secúti: et quia pro eius amóre sánguinem suum fudérunt, ídeo cum Christo exsúltant sine fine.
text.en: In heaven do rejoice the souls of the Saints * who have followed the steps of Christ; and because they shed their blood for the love of Christ, therefore shall they be made glad for ever with Christ.

text.la: Da, quǽsumus, omnípotens Deus: ut, qui beatórum Mártyrum tuórum Ianuárii et Sociórum eius solémnia cólimus, eórum apud te intercessiónibus adiuvémur.
text.en: Da, quǽsumus, omnípotens Deus: ut, qui beatórum Mártyrum tuórum Januarius and companions solémnia cólimus, eórum apud te intercessiónibus adjuvémur.

office.title: S. Januarii Episcopi et Sociorum Martyrum
